  "source_groundedness": 0.75,
  "rationale": "Most added columns (Complaint_Count, Low_Rating_Count, Has_Major_Complaint, Service_Comfort_Gap, Rating_Variance) provide genuine axes for explaining non-recommendation and are largely derivable from the review text and existing rating fields.
